The '''Vazooans''' were a [[Hair|furry]] [[humanoid]] species that existed in [[the galaxy]]. [[Roona (individual)|Roona]] from the [[planet]] [[At Attin]] was a member of this [[species]].<ref name="Real Adventure" />

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Vazooans first appeared in "[[This Could Be a Real Adventure]],"<ref name="Real Adventure" /> the first episode of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'', which aired on [[December 2]], [[2024]].<ref name="Early">{{SW|url=news/skeleton-crew-premiere-date|text=''Star Wars: Skeleton Crew'' Will Debut Early|date=2024-11-26}}</ref> Prior to the release of the episode, the individual [[Roona (individual)|Roona]] was pictured in the show's first trailer, which was released on [[August 10]], 2024.<ref name="Trailer">{{SWYouTube|a6voXgBlmpk|Skeleton Crew | Official Trailer | Streaming December 3 on Disney+|date=August 10, 2024}}</ref>
